question: Kelucharan Mohapatra is associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian classical dancer, guru, and exponent of Odissi dance, who is credited with the revival and popularizing of this classical dance form in the 20th century.**
 
• Mohapatra was immersed in the arts from an early age. He began his dance training under Guru Pankaj Charan Das at the age of seven and later studied with other renowned Odissi masters.
 
• Mohapatra's contributions to Odissi dance were significant. He expanded the dance's repertoire by incorporating elements from ancient texts and sculptures, and he refined its technique and expression.
 
• He also played a key role in bringing Odissi to a wider audience, both domestically and internationally. His performances were praised for their grace, energy, and spirituality.
